_comment: Copy the 'google' entry into any MCP client's server map. Use an ABSOLUTE path to launch.sh. The launcher loads its own secret from ~/.secrets/google.env and runs taylorwilsdon/workspace-mcp via uvx (needs 'uv' on PATH: ~/.local/bin). Tools: Gmail + Calendar, single-user. OAuth token cached in ~/.secrets/google/credentials -> Seafile-synced = connect once, everywhere. One-time auth: bash ~/.claude/mcp-servers/google/auth-once.sh
